description: ACI 369 Rectangular Column Database is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Ekin Gultepe, University of Canterbury (canterbury.ac.nz). This database was created as part of an effort by the American Concrete Institute (ACI) Committee 369 (Seismic Repair and Rehabilitation) to update provisions in the American Society of Civil Engineers (ASCE) Standard 41-06 Supplement No. 1 (2007), entitled 'Seismic Rehabilitation of Existing Structures,' pertaining to reinforced concrete structures. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 3 top-level files (CSV, PDF). Its DOI is 10.4231/d36688j50. Keywords: ACI 369, rectangular columns ,  earthquake engineering,  reinforced concrete,  database,  structural performance. Published 2013-03-08. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
